channel.title: Xtend Journal
channel.description: Engineering notes from building Xtend: terminals, PTYs, WebRTC, SwiftTerm, StoreKit, the parts nobody documents.

item.title: Why Claude Code garbles when you rotate your phone
item.description: Two weeks on column widths, one measurement that ended them, and the thing every "attach to a running session" implementation gets wrong. PTYs, SIGWINCH, width-blind scrollback, APC markers, two SwiftTerm bugs, and why the fix was to fork instead of mirror.
